data.long_meaning: The name Khusbakht is of Persian origin and means 'joy' or 'happiness'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl in Islamic culture, signifying a life filled with contentment and satisfaction. The name Khusbakht carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khusbakht usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
